authority: Program Chairs' camera-ready requests (decision 2026-10-29): moved-goal test, pose-belief and evaluation-policy clarification with loop-rate reporting; author 2026-10-31: take the upper limit, GPU 1.
checkpoints: seeds30 main family (6 arms x 30 seeds), sha256 bound by data/audit/wacv_fresh_rooms_confirm_claude/GO.json
rooms: 16 fresh confirmation rooms (fresh_geometry_manifest.json, generated 2026-10-14 before any outcome)
probe: wacv_continual_factorial_claude.probe unchanged: 10 native starts x 3 textures = 30 trials/room, 45 decisions, clean

conditions.greedy_source: argmax of the same action probabilities, goal (3,3)
conditions.sample_moved: multinomial sample, each of 3 moved goals

moved_goal_rule: targets (3,6),(6,3),(6,6); nearest walkable non-start cell reachable from every start (Manhattan, row, col)

primary.M1: moved goal (sample, mean over 3 goals x 16 rooms): human_bc - human_legal_uniform, paired t over 30 seeds

secondary.L1: revisit rate and trapped fraction per arm (all conditions incl. registered records); human_bc - human_legal_uniform paired
secondary.L2: old-goal attraction: fraction of moved-goal episodes entering (3,3), human_bc - human_legal_uniform and - cold
secondary.B1: pose belief top-1 / within-1 accuracy and mean posterior at the true cell, per condition, incl. retrospective generality relit/retextured records
secondary.BC: held-out BC accuracy and NLL (5 trial-grouped folds, same net/recipe, 3 seeds) for real, legal-uniform, sham and shortest-path labels

reading: moved-goal gain positive and Holm p<.05 => choice content beyond goal memory; otherwise claims restricted to same-goal transfer
